postal_system.assignment_rule: A pinned Ukrposhta postcode-directory row, address lookup, or API response establishes a five-digit routing assignment at its capture time. UPU syntax and structurally valid digits do not establish current allocation or service availability.
postal_system.perimeter_rule: A postcode, post-office point, delivery zone, replacement-office relation, or administrative code is not automatically an official postal polygon. A rights-cleared address-membership surface is versioned, uncertainty-bearing, and explicitly derived.
postal_system.address_rule: Exact address display requires a pinned public-field assertion from Ukrposhta or the Unified State Address Register, including its identifier, status, hierarchy, capture time, and permitted-use basis; search access alone does not establish bulk retention or redistribution rights.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires the same authoritative address/building identifier or a reviewed explicit crosswalk to the Register of Buildings and Structures or a competent NSDI layer. Address points, parcels, footprints, containment, and proximity remain candidates.
postal_system.administrative_rule: KATOTTG and competent Ukrainian administrative-boundary data supply hierarchy and clipping context only; they do not create postal membership without Ukrposhta evidence.
postal_system.service_status_rule: Ukrposhta AVAILBLE, LOCK_CODE, replacement-office, closure, and routing fields are time-stamped operational evidence. They may qualify current service but never delete historical assignment or prove a permanent perimeter.
postal_system.territory_rule: Postal assignment, missing service, replacement routing, a foreign operator, occupation, or control never determines sovereignty or a legal boundary. UA country and disputed-feature classification must cite a separately pinned boundary authority, policy, coverage, and vintage.

temporal_model.valid_time: Postal assignment, address, building, administrative boundary, and service availability validity when supplied by the source.
temporal_model.known_time: Source publication, capture, ingest, correction, service check, restriction, and release timestamps retained independently.
temporal_model.history_rule: New Ukrposhta, register, or competent boundary evidence appends a versioned assertion and never silently rewrites an earlier release or turns operational outage into territorial history.

quality_gates.pass: Each full code references a pinned Ukrposhta directory row, lookup, or API receipt with five-digit text preserved, address or office scope, capture time, rights, and digest.
Operational availability, closure, lock, and replacement-office facts retain source fields and observation time and remain separate from assignment, geometry, and sovereignty.
Every derived surface retains member addresses, method, boundary clips, exclusions, outages, uncertainty, rights, temporal lineage, and digest and is never labelled official.
Each exact address retains a Ukrposhta or Unified State Address Register identifier, status, hierarchy, permitted fields, access terms, capture time, and postal cross-check result.
An exact building has a common authoritative address/building identifier or reviewed explicit crosswalk; parcel, footprint, containment, and proximity are candidate-only.
Each NSDI, KATOTTG, building, or boundary artifact retains producer, public-access state, security restriction, coverage, territorial policy, vintage, CRS, terms, and digest.
No addressee, resident, owner, rightsholder, occupant, phone, credential, military or security-sensitive site, cadastral-right, or protected register field is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights, access restrictions, operational status, territorial policy, coverage, and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current complete Ukrposhta five-digit postal-index assignment, operational exception and explicit non-area denominator is fixed under resource-specific rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Every drawable index reconciles to a fixed finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon whose official/derived/virtual class, provider, edition, reference date, rights, attribution, bytes, SHA-256, schema, CRS, topology, member-address denominator, exclusions, wartime/service gaps, territorial policy, method and confidence are recorded; non-area route, P.O.-box, organization and service cases retain source-grounded reasons. Address and office rows, office coordinates, KATOTTG/administrative boundaries, settlements, streets, buildings, parcels, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never become postal perimeters by implication, and postal/service evidence never changes UA identity, sovereignty, occupation or control. The approved immutable artifact drives the real UA API/app, which normalizes five text digits, handles loading/no-match/multiple/API-failure/invalid-geometry, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline, and displays selected index, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, security, freshness, outage, territorial-policy, and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
